one_liner: Read-only risk check on any address: 8 real on-chain checks — age, transaction pattern, balance, contract-vs-wallet, activity window. No judgment, just data.
what_it_does: Paste any address and this lamp runs 8 real on-chain checks — how old the account is, its transaction patterns, whether it's a contract or a wallet — and reports plain data, no verdicts. It costs nothing to run and moves no funds. Proven by live reads pinned to a real block on the Atlantic testnet.
